sheets.character_en: The Cook, a female adult: a big, broad-shouldered, brawny English kitchen cook of about forty-five, about 168 cm tall, a human actress. Coarse dark red-brown hair greying at the temples, frizzing out from under the mob cap. Narrow, squinting, sullen dark brown eyes; a broad, square face with heavy cheeks, thick brows and a set, sullen mouth; red, shiny skin from the fire; brawny forearms with pepper dust and soot smudges. Sullen, aggressive expression. She holds a large battered tin pepper-box in one hand.

Character: The Cook, a female adult: a big, broad-shouldered, brawny English kitchen cook of about forty-five, about 168 cm tall, a human actress. Coarse dark red-brown hair greying at the temples, frizzing out from under the mob cap. Narrow, squinting, sullen dark brown eyes; a broad, square face with heavy cheeks, thick brows and a set, sullen mouth; red, shiny skin from the fire; brawny forearms with pepper dust and soot smudges. Sullen, aggressive expression. She holds a large battered tin pepper-box in one hand. Costume: an 1862 kitchen servant's working dress: a faded brown cotton dress with a plain full skirt and no crinoline, sleeves rolled above the elbow, a large stained coarse-linen apron dusted with pepper, a crumpled white cotton mob cap pushed askew, and sturdy black boots; greasy, smoke-dulled and pepper-dusted. Style: Photorealistic live-action fantasy film rooted in England in 1862, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lenses, 16:9 widescreen. Real sets, real locations and real costumed actors in 1862 dress. Wonderland spaces are real built sets and set extensions in an Alphonse Mucha-inspired Art Nouveau design: flowing organic lines, floral and vine ornament, circular halo roundels, mosaic and stained glass, aged pastel-and-gold surfaces with patina and moss; the waking 1862 meadow stays plain period realism. Talking animals and fantastical creatures are photoreal CGI animals with naturalistic anatomy, real fur, feathers, skin and scales, lit by the same light and grounded with real contact shadows. Natural and practical light: sunlight, candlelight and oil lamps, soft haze with volumetric light shafts and soft colour through stained glass. Restrained palette of verdigris teal, slate grey, dusty rose, soft sage and lilac pastels and tarnished-gold accents, warmed by amber sun and candle glow. Fine film grain, gentle halation, soft depth of field, grounded and quietly melancholy. Layout recap (highest priority): four separate photographic panels side by side on one sheet: front, side profile, back, head-and-shoulders close-up; plain studio backdrop; never one single full-bleed picture.
